# Confirmatory design

Source is Burr Settles' CC BY-NC 4.0 Duolingo public learning traces, file 3091087. Use the SHA-256 pins for data and MIT reference implementation in the parent protocol. Keep the previous reports intact. Sample by the first four SHA-256 bytes of the UTF-8 learner ID, interpreted unsigned big-endian modulo 100. Prior experiments used buckets 0–9. Use entire learner traces from 10–11 for training, 12 for calibration, 13 for selection/stacking and 14–17 for a single test. The four test buckets are one pooled cohort. Treat forecasting the next recorded item encounter in an already scheduled session as the task. Equal learner weight, equal row weight within learner. No claim about changing the schedule.

Candidate is a convex probability ensemble with weights estimated on development learners, incorporating matched enriched CatBoost, histogram gradient boosting, enriched logistic and enriched exponential forgetting. Probabilities may be positively slope/intercept recalibrated on the calibration bucket. Use the same selected calibrated component as both standalone control and ensemble input. Preserve the published HLR, authors' logistic model, log-feature logistic, original-feature CatBoost and a constant as additional controls. Include both raw and recalibrated choices for every trained control and both equal-learner and unweighted options for original CatBoost. The code fixes all hyperparameter grids before scoring. The historical controls intentionally retain their native representations. Each model class also has a full-feature representative. Train-only item difficulty estimated out of learner fold, common to the enriched models. The information set excludes the current and subsequent response counts, except for constructing the scored target. Previous learner or learner-item sessions within this release can update summaries online, including in the test partition. All rows at one learner timestamp are predicted before the group updates these summaries. No cross-user test label pooling.

Serialize the selected models, calibration, item lookup and stacking weights. Write a manifest of their digests together with protocol and script digests before the test stage can run. Run the frozen specification once. Compare each control minus ensemble in learner-average fractional binary log loss. Original practical threshold is 0.005 nats. Report two-sided paired learner t intervals with Bonferroni simultaneous coverage, and one-sided Holm step-down tests at zero and 0.005 with compatible simultaneous lower bounds at the practical margin. At a partially rejected family the rejected lower bounds are the margin, and unrejected lower bounds use the number remaining. When all reject use the larger of margin and the Bonferroni lower bound. A counted improvement requires each point gain >= 0.005 and each Holm-adjusted margin test p < .05. Report all contrasts, all development trials and interpretable class limitations regardless of decision. Inference conditions on the fitted models and assumes independent learner clusters with a valid large-sample mean approximation. No exploratory follow-up on test.
